description: Illustrative homogeneous joint MNL baseline for route and departure choice. Engineering assumptions; not calibrated. Freeze independently before comparisons.

timeWeight.source: Engineering assumption reusing the legacy route-only MNL time sensitivity as a starting point; not an empirical estimate.

moneyWeight.source: Engineering assumption for sensitivity testing; scenario money is not asserted to be USD or RMB. Not inferred from income categories.

lateWeight.source: Engineering assumption: additional lateness sensitivity is three times the travel-time sensitivity. Not calibrated, not copied from MATSim full-plan scoring.

departureShiftWeight.source: Engineering assumption: symmetric disutility of departing earlier or later than the original plan. No hard punctuality filter or inferred preparation period.

experienceWeight.source: Engineering assumption: equal blend of static free-flow time and mean completed own same-route/same-bin travel time in the configured recent factual window.

experienceBinSeconds.source: Engineering assumption matching the default 15-minute departure grid; absolute time-of-day bins applied to selected, not delayed actual, departure times.
